title: Student Lesson Report – Student Detail – Authorized Centre Staff – Opens the selected student's report
description: AC 01.1 — Permission Matrix — An authorized Centre Staff member opens the report from the selected Student detail page.
preconditions:
- Centre Staff A is logged in to Salesforce and has permission to view Student A at Tokyo Center.
- Student A has one current-academic-year lesson at Tokyo Center.
- The Student A detail page contains the Student Lesson Report entry point.
steps_actions: 1. Centre Staff A opens the Student A detail page.\n2. Centre Staff A selects the Student Lesson Report entry point.\n3. Centre Staff A reads the report row.
steps_result: 1. The Student A detail page identifies Student A and shows the Student Lesson Report entry point.\n2. Salesforce opens a report scoped to Student A.\n3. The row belongs to Student A and includes the prepared current-academic-year lesson.
steps_data: 1. Student = Student A; Location = Tokyo Center\n2. Report context = Student A\n3. Lesson = Lesson Tokyo 01
suite: EEA | Core | Student's Lesson Report or Lesson Classroom info in Lesson object

title: Student Lesson Report – Student Detail – Restricted-location staff – Does not expose another center's report
description: AC 01.1 — Permission Matrix / Negative — A staff member without access to Student A's location cannot read Student A's report data.
preconditions:
- Centre Staff B is logged in to Salesforce with access to Osaka Center only.
- Student A belongs to Tokyo Center.
- Student A has one current-academic-year lesson at Tokyo Center.
steps_actions: 1. Centre Staff B attempts to open the Student A detail page.\n2. Centre Staff B attempts to open the Student Lesson Report from any available Student A route.
steps_result: 1. Salesforce denies access or does not expose Student A's record.\n2. Salesforce does not display Student A's lesson or attendance data.
steps_data: 1. Staff location = Osaka Center; Student location = Tokyo Center\n2. Student = Student A
suite: EEA | Core | Student's Lesson Report or Lesson Classroom info in Lesson object

title: Student Lesson Report – Student Detail – User without report permission – Keeps the report unavailable
description: AC 01.1 — Permission Matrix / Negative — A user lacking report permission cannot open the Student Lesson Report.
preconditions:
- User C is logged in to Salesforce without the permission that grants Student Lesson Report access.
- Student A is visible to User C through a permitted non-report route.
- Student A has one current-academic-year lesson.
steps_actions: 1. User C opens the Student A detail page.\n2. User C inspects the Student Lesson Report entry point.
steps_result: 1. The Student A detail page opens without exposing report data.\n2. The entry point is unavailable, disabled, or opening it is denied without displaying Student A's report rows.
steps_data: 1. Student = Student A\n2. User permission = Report access absent
suite: EEA | Core | Student's Lesson Report or Lesson Classroom info in Lesson object
